title: Drummers: Leo Addy, Buddy Rich and the tag ending
summary: Braud recalls a young drummer who made others look bad, compares him to Buddy Rich, and says the drum tag ending is old.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Do you remember the boy used to be a Dorfian? White boy? No, no. No. I didn't know that. He made drummers look bad today. They seem to play in three and four chords by themselves. That was Leo Addy.
I don't know who it was.
Well, he used to break up that often. People used to go there and say, yeah, that drummer. The band, get out of the pit. The closest thing I've seen to that kid is Buddy Rich.

Well, in the old days here. Buddy Rich is the best solo drum player out there today. Did they ever use what Baby calls that tag ending with the band stops and the drummer plays four bars and they come in again?
Oh, yeah. They used that. They come and use it. Some of the records we made it over.
A long time ago, though. Did they use it when you were a kid? Do you remember that?
Oh, yeah. They used that. That's old. That isn't anything new.
